params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the card order.

params.name: offset
params.description:
Specifies the position of an element in a list of card orders. The response includes a list of card order items that starts at the specified offset.

**Default:** 0, which means that the response contains all the elements in the list of card order items.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of card order items returned per page. **Default:** 10.

items.docs: Returns the item list of a specific card order.
